title: 機械の原理・演習
subtitle: Mechanical Principles/ Exercises
keywords: Characteristics of machines 2.Structure and motion principles of machines 3.Disassembling/assembling and measurement 4.Materials and production of machines 5.3D-CAD
educationalGoal: Students will: (1)understand the definition of machine. (2)learn the basics of mechanical engineering. (3)disassemble and assemble an actual machine. (4)learn the structure, mechanism, and principles of the machine. (5)learn the effective use of 3D-CAD software.
advice: This is an introductory subject of mechanical engineering. We will cover the following: 1. Lectures and actual works 2. Basics of mechanical engineering 3. Basics of mechanical elements 4. How to use tools and measuring instruments 5. How to disassemble/assemble 6. Effective use of 3D-CAD software Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are required to understand the names of the mechanical elements. Students are required to understand the major field of mechanical engineering. Students are required to understand how to use tools. Students are required to understand how to use 3D-CAD software.
books: Textbooks:(1)Introduction to Mechanical Engineering, Maruzen Publishing Co., Ltd. (in Japanese) (2)Instruction Textbook of Experience, Kanazawa Institute of Technology (in Japanese) (3)New JIS Mechanical Drawing (5th edition), Morikita Publishing Co., Ltd. (in Japanese) (4)JIS Mechanical Drawing Operation Method Using Solid Edge, Kanazawa Institute of Technology (in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: Participate actively in experience activities. For safety during experience activities, students should wear proper work clothes and shoes. Reports should be submitted by the deadline.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the importance of the structure, materials, mechanism, and principles of motion.
Be able to disassemble and assemble machines and machine parts.
Be able to explain the structure, materials, mechanism and principles of motion of a machine.
Be able to submit a report on the importance and problems of the mechanism of a machine.
Be able to create easy models by understanding how to use 3D-CAD software.
Be able to understand the names and the linkages of the major subject to learn in mechanical engineering.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Describe the detailed characteristics of the machines used in experience activities. (2) Sketch a figure of a mechanical element, and explain the details. (3) Explain the details of the manufacturing method of the machine, and link this with the characteristics of each mechanical element. (4) Create mechanical element models by understanding the functions of 3D-CAD software. (5) Submit an exemplary report by the scheduled date. (6) Enumerate associated major subjects, and link them with the characteristics of each mechanical element.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Describe the characteristics of the machines to be use in experience activities. (2) Sketch a figure of a mechanical element. (3) Explain the manufacturing method of a machine. (4) Create easy models using 3D-CAD software. (5) Submit a report by the scheduled date. (6) Enumerate associated major subjects.
